title: Compartment Record
governance_note: Compartments should not be treated as exact reality without definition and validation.

title: Transmission Record
governance_note: Transmission parameters can hide behavior, contact, biology, and environment.

title: Observation Record
governance_note: Reported cases should not be treated as true infections without observation assumptions.

title: Intervention Record
governance_note: Intervention effects should not be represented as unexplained reductions.

title: Immunity Record
governance_note: Immunity assumptions can strongly change long-run dynamics.

title: Uncertainty Record
governance_note: Epidemiological outputs should be presented with uncertainty and purpose.

title: Claim Boundary
governance_note: Epidemiological conclusions should not exceed compartment definitions, data evidence, uncertainty, domain review, and tested scope.
